selectionRule: Evaluate unused BabySlakh tracks Track00002 through Track00017 in ascending numerical order. Using metadata and source audio only, require a rendered mix of at least 90 seconds and an authored Piano stem. Generate the frozen baseline and v002 candidate without parsing all_src.mid. Stop at the first track where v002 reports at least 200 melody events, at least 200 harmony events, melody median MIDI in [60,72), and melody-minus-harmony median gap in [0,7]. Only that selected track's target may then be opened once.
disallowedSelectionSignals: human listening to the authored target
